name: get-resq-software
description: Pinned, hash-verified distribution Worker for get.resq.software
//: devDependencies only, deliberately. This Worker ships zero runtime
dependencies: the deployed bundle is src/index.ts and nothing else, so
no third-party code reaches the endpoint that serves install scripts.
Versions are exact, not ranged. A caret here would mean the toolchain
that produces the bytes users pipe into a shell could change without a
reviewed commit, which is the same property PINS exists to deny.
Deploys are performed by Cloudflare Workers Builds from main using its
own wrangler; these pins keep local builds and CI typechecking against
known versions rather than whatever npm resolves that day.
